_status: ASSUMPTIONS, NOT PROJECT DATA. Replace with the State Schedule of Rates / PMGSY design values before any financial use. The project has no road-width, cross-section or cost data; none of these values was measured or verified.

rate_lakh_per_km.source: central value supplied by the project owner as a PMGSY-based rate; not verified against a PMGSY document or a State SOR. Low/high are +/-20% for sensitivity only.

pavement.note: Typical order-of-magnitude values for a single-lane rural road with a bituminous surface; bitumen rate is a round assumption covering tack, binder and seal coat.
